t: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
That Day, the people will depart
separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
So whoever does an atom's weight
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

f.1964: From the place of Judgement to their final abode. Another interpretation is "emerge separately" (from the graves).
f.1965: Or "the weight of a small ant."
